name: Kiln
description: Fired-clay editorial system: warm near-black ground, one ember accent on a strict budget, a variable serif whose softness rises with size, three lit elevation levels, grain on every large fill. Dark-first with a rebuilt light theme.
suits: developer tools with an editorial voice
changelogs, documentation meant to be read
long-form marketing where warmth is an asset
avoid: dense operational UI (trading terminals, admin tables at 12px rows)
briefs that explicitly want the cool blue-black SaaS dialect
multi-brand surfaces that cannot commit to one accent

signature.truth: the work is the material, so the index shows the artefact rather than describing it

source.origin: Authored for DesignOS. Not derived from, and deliberately not an imitation of, any shipping product's design language (brain/originality.md swap test).
